summary: Provides guidance on how the ITU-T and the Internet Society and IETF collaborate on standards development. It reflects changes in both organizations since RFC 2436, which it replaces, and much of its text is shared with the ITU-T. It was later replaced by RFC 6756.

eli5.summary: Two big groups that write technical rules sometimes work on the same subjects. This document explains how they should cooperate so they do not step on each other.

questions: how do the ietf and itu-t collaborate
what are the ietf itu-t collaboration guidelines
